units.source_text: "美是……"话刚出口，我就结结巴巴，思绪翩跹，毫无规律。

en.t: "Beauty is..." The words had barely left my mouth when I began to stammer, my thoughts fluttering about in utter disorder.

units.source_text: 这时候，我的脑海里生起了一个疑团：

en.t: At that moment, a doubt arose in my mind:

units.source_text: 我的结巴，难道不就是从我的美的观念中产生出来的吗？

en.t: Could it be that my stammer had arisen precisely from my idea of beauty?

units.source_text: "美……美的东西，对我来说，是怨敌。"

en.t: "Beauty... beautiful things, to me, are bitter enemies."
